brief: Holds a list without repeats, a mathematical set, and gives its union, intersection and difference with other lists.
detail: A set is built with new stzSet(aList) or StzSetQ(aList) and drops every repeated item on the way in, keeping the first of each; case counts, so a and A are two elements. It is a stzList underneath, so the stzList methods are available on it, and stzListFlattener.ToStzSet hands one back. UnionWith, IntersectionWith and DifferenceWith return a plain list and leave the set as it was, their Q form wrapping the answer in a new stzSet; UnifyWith and the Update family change the set in place. Several guards raise the wrong error today: init, Update and UnionWith call a function (stzSetError) that does not exist, so a bad argument raises R3 instead of the intended message; AddElement only accepts a list element; Includes and Contains take a list of elements and cannot test one item; Updated simply returns its argument; Subsets, SubSetsOfNElements and NumberOfSubsets are TODO and answer nothing. Hebrew, Arabic and emoji elements are kept like any other text.
